title: Earth's Five Spheres
summary: The atmosphere, hydrosphere, cryosphere, geosphere and biosphere, and how they interact.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 13: Earth as a System: Energy, Matter and Life

objectives: I can name and describe Earth’s five spheres.
I can trace how one event affects several spheres.
I can explain why Earth is studied as a system.
misconceptions: The spheres are separate layers that don’t affect each other.
Ice is part of the hydrosphere only.
Humans are outside the Earth system.
